title: Balance Tweaks
description:
[h2]Small, targeted card and relic balance tweaks.[/h2]
Each tweak is a separate patch and can be switched on or off in [b]Settings > General[/b] (restart the game to apply).

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Master Planner[/b]: costs 1 energy instead of 2, and 0 when upgraded.
[*][b]Calculated Gamble[/b]: the upgrade removes Exhaust instead of adding Retain.
[*][b]Unceasing Top[/b]: also draws when your hand holds only unplayable cards (curses, statuses).
[*][b]Frozen Eye[/b]: re-added as a shop relic; when viewing your Draw Pile, the cards are shown in draw order.
[/list]

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay, so everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the mod with the same tweaks enabled.
[*]Built for game version 0.111.0. A game update can break a patch; it then logs an error and leaves the card alone.
[*]No dependencies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
changeNote: v1.2.0: Re-added Frozen Eye as a shop relic (toggleable in Settings > General).
